name: gizza-ai/wifi-qr-code-generator
summary: Generate a Wi-Fi join QR code.

tool.description: Generate a Wi-Fi join QR code from an SSID, password and security type, as an SVG. Scanning it with a phone camera offers to connect to the network — no typing the password. security is WPA (default; covers WPA/WPA2/WPA3), WEP, or nopass (open); set hidden=true for a non-broadcast SSID. Returns an SVG image. Runs locally — the credentials never leave the device.

password.description: The Wi-Fi password (required for WPA/WEP; omit for an open network).

security.description: Security type: WPA (default, covers WPA/WPA2/WPA3), WEP, or nopass (open network).

hidden.description: Set true if the network's SSID is hidden (not broadcast).
